paragraphs.text: Free Urborg was a small group of humans and panther folk that resisted the reign of the Cabal on Urborg , Dominaria . Their leader was Marivel .

The group of fewer than 200 individuals lived in hiding. They sabotaged the Cabal where they could, occasionally killing small patrols and raiding caravans. The protective powers of Vhelnish , the lost lich city, kept the Cabal from finding them. The local cabalists decided not to raise the issue to Belzenlok , fearing punishment for their incompetence.
It is unknown what happened to Free Urborg after the death of Belzenlok.
